text:
maria: Hey - hitting a weird onboarding hiccup with the Node quickstart sample app. First request returns 200 and a token, then immediately the next /v1/chat request gets 401 and our SDK goes into an auth-retry loop. Workspace shows no billing banner. :confused:

maria: Logs attached from the sample app run:```
[2026-03-21T18:20:12.345Z] INFO  request id=abc123 POST /v1/chat 200
[2026-03-21T18:20:12.678Z] INFO  token cached ttl=55s
[2026-03-21T18:20:13.900Z] WARN  request id=abc124 POST /v1/chat 401 unauthorized
[2026-03-21T18:20:13.901Z] ERROR retrying auth, attempt=1
[2026-03-21T18:20:14.101Z] ERROR retrying auth, attempt=2
```

tim: Can you paste the exact env vars you used and whether this is `API_KEY` vs service-account?

maria: Using the Node sample from repo: `REDWOOD_API_KEY` set to the workspace API key in the .env of the sample. No service account. I also tried `curl -v` and saw the same 401 on the second call.

lee: Two quick things we hit before: 1) proxy header rewrite stripping `Authorization` in weird k8s ingress rules, 2) short-lived session tokens that require `x-request-id`. Any chance the sample app forks multiple connections?

maria: It's a single-process sample. I noticed the 200 goes to `us-west-2` and the 401 goes to `eu-central-1` in the logs, even though region env is `us-west-2`. Could be smart-routing fallback?

sylvia: @maria that routing mismatch is a red flag. We had a rollout last week that changed fallback routing for new workspaces and there was a proxy bug where the authorization header wasn't preserved on cross-region failover. :thinking:

sylvia: Short-term workaround: set `REDWOOD_FORCE_REGION=us-west-2` in the sample env to prevent fallback and confirm behavior. Also try `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=1` to avoid the loop.

maria: Applying force region now... repro steps updated: `export REDWOOD_FORCE_REGION=us-west-2 && node sample/index.js` -> second call now 200, no retry loop. Works. Thanks.

tim: Ok that's consistent with the header-drop on cross-region path. Sylvie/sylvia can we confirm if this affects hosted quickstart users? Might explain a few onboarding tickets.

sylvia: I'll open an internal tracer to correlate. If confirmed, plan: patch proxy -> preserve Authorization on failover + small SDK change to make retry backoff bounded for 401 when coming from token failure. I'll file issue and a hotfix.

sylvia: Filing: INC-2026-345 (internal), PR drafted: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/3456 . Workaround documented in quickstart README: set `REDWOOD_FORCE_REGION` until rollout completes.

maria: Leaving this thread here in case someone else hits it while onboarding. Thanks team! :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for infra/patches#3456, status: queued.

maria: Follow-up: I'd also like a note in the self-serve UI to warn new tenants if their first call hits a region mismatch while billing is still unflagged. It caused confusion with the user thinking billing was the issue.

sylvia: Good suggestion — adding to the onboarding checklist item.

maria: Closing for now, tagging this thread in the sample-app troubleshooting doc.
